author: Nemoo00
quote: 13 years. 2Billion dollars.  A game of running erands, fixing the house, buying flowers and doing all sorts of Sims style missions, and if youre waiting for the game pick up and start with the real GTA type missions, youll still be waiting for it while watching the end credits after a horrible ending.  Which, by the way, will be at the second day of you gaming.  Yes, 2 days to finish this disaster.  Why would anyone wanna be in a couple in GTA to begin with? or atleast not one thats been forced on us by the developers?  And where is the escapism? Were trying to get lost in another world for a few precious hours, and then you find yourself sitting on the couch, watching some idiotic TV show with your annoyingly annoying girlfriend while listening to her yapping about her friends drama and rubbing her feet.  Really, GTA?  Im a girl, and to me Jason comes off as clingy, dry af, sticky and one hell of a pushover.  The worse GTA main character of all times. Worse story that doesnt go anywhere, worse character development, the lack of any kind of offesive humor or satire is overwhelming, makes u feel like u visited the pharmacy.  Hope its gonna be the most refunded game of all times.
